recorded.prompt:q-space-mismatch: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-mismatch: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-space-mismatch: Decided directly: 1.2 says the queue name and the Space must both match, and with no session reading, the log has the channel's <receive> and then nothing until the Context expires unread.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-jar: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-jar: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-jar: Decided by short inference: 1.3.1 shows a participant class that cannot be loaded failing in init with one warning, the file keeping its name, and QServer starting normally; a missing jar is the same class-not-found failure.
recorded.prompt:q-context-dump: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-context-dump: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-context-dump: Decided directly: 1.6 says debug-context follows debug, which is on by default, and the Context dump in the transaction event prints the card number and track 2 in clear.
recorded.prompt:q-busy-sessions: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-busy-sessions: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-busy-sessions: Decided directly: 1.2 says the listener's timeout is the longest a request may wait for a free session and the Context then expires from the queue unread, and the 1.8 table gives timeout as the ms the Context may wait in the queue.

recorded.prompt:q-space-mismatch:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-mismatch:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-space-mismatch:b: Refuted by short inference: 1.2 says the listener put the Context into the queue and moved on, and the Context expired only after the timeout, so the listener does not drop it.
recorded.prompt:q-space-mismatch:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-mismatch:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-space-mismatch:c: Refuted directly: 1.2 says a Space with another name has its own queues, so the name and the Space must both match.
recorded.prompt:q-space-mismatch:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-space-mismatch:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-space-mismatch:d: Refuted directly: 1.2 names tspace:switch as another Space with queues of its own.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-jar:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-jar:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-jar:a: Refuted directly: 1.3.1 says a failure inside init leaves the file as it is and QServer in the next file started normally.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-jar:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-jar:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-jar:b: Refuted directly: 1.3.1 says Q2 renames a descriptor only when it can't read, build or configure it, and a failure inside init leaves the file as it is.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-jar:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-jar:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-jar:c: Refuted directly: 1.3.1 says QBeanSupport logs the failure and carries on, and QServer started normally and listened on port 8000.
recorded.prompt:q-context-dump:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-context-dump:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-context-dump:a: Refuted directly: 1.6 says ProtectedLogListener masks only a message that is itself in the event, and the Context is turned into text before any listener sees it.
recorded.prompt:q-context-dump:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-context-dump:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-context-dump:b: Refuted directly: 1.4 shows the TransactionManager's <abort> event for the refused 0200, and 1.6 shows the Context dump in such an <abort> event.
recorded.prompt:q-context-dump:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-context-dump:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-context-dump:d: Refuted directly: 1.6 says the channel's <receive> is masked and shows the masked fields 2 and 35.
recorded.prompt:q-busy-sessions:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-busy-sessions:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-busy-sessions:b: Refuted by short inference: 1.2 and the 1.8 table define the timeout as the Context's wait in the queue, and nothing on the page has the listener close a connection.
recorded.prompt:q-busy-sessions:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-busy-sessions:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-busy-sessions:c: Refuted directly: 1.2 says that after the listener's timeout the Context expired from the queue unread.
recorded.prompt:q-busy-sessions:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-busy-sessions:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-busy-sessions:d: Refuted by short inference: 1.1's path sends every request, the echo included, through the queue to a session, and 1.2's own unanswered example is an echo.
